exposure: Robson groups (gestational age, fetal presentation, number of fetus, onset of labour, history of CS)
cohort: 980 women who underwent CS from January 2016 to April 2017 at a university hospital in eastern Ethiopia
finding: Robson groups 3 (multiparous women with single cephalic full-term pregnancy in spontaneous labor with no history of CS), group 5 (multiparous women with single cephalic full-term pregnancy with a history of CS), and group 1 (single cephalic nulliparous women full-term pregnancy in spontaneous labor) were the largest contributors to the overall CS rate.
